note: Set B correctly classifies window tags (W1, W2) as identifiers, whereas Set A incorrectly labels them as dimensions, which is a significant semantic error in engineering data. Set A is more accurate regarding the PV array grid location (4-5 vs 4-6) and captures the specific tube count (40), but it suffers from excessive duplication of elevation claims (e.g., Finished Floor listed 4 times). Set B is preferred for better semantic binding of attributes despite the minor grid line inaccuracy.
